WITH gender_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    c.gender,
    COUNT(i.invoice_number) as invoice_count
  FROM Invoices i
  JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.gender IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.gender
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(invoice_count) as total_invoices,
    COUNT(*) as gender_count
  FROM gender_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    gc.gender,
    gc.invoice_count,
    CAST(gc.invoice_count AS DECIMAL(19,4)) / CAST(t.total_invoices AS DECIMAL(19,4)) as share,
    CAST(1 AS DECIMAL(19,4)) / CAST(t.gender_count AS DECIMAL(19,4)) as avg_share
  FROM gender_counts gc
  CROSS JOIN totals t
)
SELECT 
  gender,
  invoice_count as count,
  share,
  share - avg_share as above_average
FROM with_shares
WHERE share > avg_share
ORDER BY share DESC
